messages:
Marta (PM): Need a quick decision: for the enterprise pilot do we sell a simple pilot bundle (signed export manifests + BYOK JWK signing, retention lanes 30d/1y/7y, async export best-effort <4h) or a premium SLA tier (gold <2h, priority assemble, SOC2 attachments included)? Customers want predictable pricing. Thoughts?
Chen (Eng): Pilot bundle is fastest. Tech caveat: gold <2h needs parallel assembler + reserved capacity, adds infra + egress cost. We can toggle priority flag on exports but gold requires capacity reservation.
Asha (Security): Security requirements same either way: tenant-bound key IDs, replay-protected export tokens, per-file sha256 in manifest. Default redaction: redact content_preview; include content_hash. If customers require full verbatim, require signed capacity/price addendum.
Gus (Legal): For pilot we can accept async <4h in contract with an addendum for gold SLAs later. Need manifest definition clause (files + checksums + signer_kid) and a retention-exception (legal hold) API. No default escrow; explicit refusal clause required.
Pri (Sales): Customers will pay for archival storage. Recommend we offer pilot bundle as standard and a priced "Export Gold" add-on. I'll surface price sensitivity and request Finance estimate for per-GB/month + SLA fee.
Marta (PM): Decision: ship pilot bundle (signed manifests, BYOK JWK or HSM fallback, retention lanes 30d/1y/7y, async exports BE <4h). Offer Export Gold as paid add-on (parallel assemble + <2h SLA + SOC2 attachments). Action owners: Chen - prototype exporter + cost estimate (10d), Asha - security checklist (5d), Gus - contract addendum draft (3d), Pri - pricing asks to Finance (2d). Reconvene next Wed 9am PT.
export-bot: Created ticket INFR-9998: "Pilot: evidence export & BYOK pricing tiers" assigned to Chen (Eng). ETA 6 weeks.
